evidence.mammals: curated: Zoonomia phyloP over 241 placental mammals, constrained at >= 2.27
evidence.humans: curated: gnomAD Gnocchi, Z per kb from 76,156 genomes, constrained at >= 2.18 (top decile), strong at >= 4.0
evidence.case: inferred: the two axes read together; a best guess with a confidence, never a verdict

cases.syntax: constrained across mammals and among people
cases.relaxed: constrained across mammals, variable among people: a frame whose value varies, or lost
cases.recent: free across mammals, constrained among people: recent function or selection
cases.tolerant: free on both scales: tolerant, or a value slot

known_values.note: HERC2 intron 86 enhancer of OCA2; A brown, G blue (Sturm 2008)
known_values.reading: constrained across mammals at the base; its kilobase is not scored by Gnocchi
